rows.answer: The API enforces a limit of 600 requests per minute per workspace, with a burst allowance of 100 requests. [1] Scale customers can request a higher API rate limit. [4]
When a client exceeds the limit, Relay answers with HTTP status 429 Too Many Requests and error code KR-1029. [2]
KR-4291 — 409 — Idempotency key reused with a different payload. [1]

The retry schedule is 30 seconds, 2 minutes, 10 minutes, 1 hour, 6 hours and 24 hours after the previous attempt. [1]

A delivery is attempted at most 8 times in total; after the eighth failure the event moves to the dead-letter queue, where it is kept for 14 days and can be replayed manually from the dashboard or through POST /v3/deliveries/{id}/replay. [1] Dead-lettered events are kept for 14 days on every plan. [2]
Every delivery carries a Kestrel-Signature header so receivers can verify that the request came from Relay. [1]
Receivers should reject any request whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes away from their own clock to prevent replay attacks. [1]
Keys can be rotated from the dashboard at any time, and the previous key stays valid for a grace period of 24 hours so that deployments can roll over without downtime. [1]
The default page size is 50 items and the maximum is 200, set through the limit query parameter. [1]
Version 2 of the API reaches end of life on 30 June 2026. [1]
Every employee receives 25 days of paid time off per calendar year, in addition to the public holidays of their country of residence. [1]
Unused days can be carried over into the next year, up to a maximum of 5 days, and carried-over days expire on 31 March. [1]

To keep collaboration possible across time zones, everyone is expected to be reachable during core hours, from 13:00 to 16:00 UTC, Monday to Thursday. [1] Fridays have no core hours and no recurring meetings. [1]
Birth and adoptive parents receive 20 weeks of fully paid parental leave, regardless of gender. [1]
Each new employee receives a one-time home office stipend of 1,200 US dollars to buy a desk, a chair and other equipment. [1]
Every employee has an annual learning budget of 1,500 US dollars for books, courses and conferences. [1]
